extends Node
class_name SceneLoader

signal progress_updated(fraction: float)
signal load_completed(scene: PackedScene)
signal load_failed(reason: String)

var _loading_path: String = ""
var _loading_status: int = ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_INVALID

func start_load(path: String) -> bool:
    if _loading_path != "":
        return false
    
    if not ResourceLoader.exists(path):
        load_failed.emit("Path not found")
        return false
        
    var err = ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request(path)
    if err != OK:
        load_failed.emit("Load request failed")
        return false
        
    _loading_path = path
    return true

func cancel() -> void:
    if _loading_path != "":
        _loading_path = ""

func is_loading() -> bool:
    return _loading_path != ""

func _process(_delta):
    if _loading_path == "":
        return
    
    var progress = []
    _loading_status = ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(_loading_path, progress)
    
    match _loading_status:
        ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_IN_PROGRESS:
            progress_updated.emit(progress[0])
        ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_LOADED:
            var scene = ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get(_loading_path)
            _loading_path = ""
            load_completed.emit(scene)
        ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_FAILED, ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_INVALID:
            var reason = "Internal load failure"
            _loading_path = ""
            load_failed.emit(reason)
